Item transfer uses the shared save-or-restore pipeline

stages.title: First Dream Mirror is a distinct default-state mirror kind
Temporary first dream sessions regenerate pristine terrain instead of copying current chunks
First Dream uses the shared item transfer pipeline

Persistent world entry requires a matching enchanted mirror

routes.title: Permanence enchanted Heaven Mirror keeps the enchanted mirror in sandbox

stages.title: Creative sandbox hotbar mirror preserves permanence
Entering a saved heaven mirror keeps persistent access for sandbox setup

routes.title: Mirror item interactions keep cooldown, menu, portal, and hold-return behavior scoped

stages.title: Block interaction validates access and space before creating portals and applying cooldown
Air interaction only starts hold-to-return inside mirror worlds
Cooldown reduction remains tied to Efficiency and not Permanence

routes.title: Temporary mirror sessions save, enter, return, and clean up state in order

stages.title: Session creation refuses purge/duplicate sessions before allocating a temporary dimension
Session entry saves origin and inventory before teleport and return portal spawn
Temporary return restores inventory, bypasses own teleport guards, and destroys finished sessions
Heaven mirror return portals can only return through the original entrance area

routes.title: Death, external dimension changes, login, and logout restore or clean mirror state without duplication

stages.title: Mirror-world death restoration is deferred to respawn and forces overworld recovery
External dimension changes route persistent and temporary exits through the correct cleanup handlers
Login recovery returns saved mirror state to the saved origin instead of overworld spawn
Logout saves cooldown before session cleanup and local tracking cleanup
Server shutdown marks active and deferred temporary dimensions for cleanup before clearing memory

routes.title: Persistent mirror records save, enter, rename, leave, and delete through closed lifecycle gates

stages.title: Saving a persistent mirror checks permission, session permanence, duplicate-session rejection, slot allocation, and queueing
Entering a persistent mirror checks readiness, matching enchanted mirror, access rights, and active-session exclusivity
Renaming a persistent mirror resolves a player-facing selector and marks saved data dirty
Leaving a persistent mirror restores saved state before teleport cleanup and effect clearing
Deleting a persistent mirror cancels queued copy work, ejects players, cleans the persistent world, and removes the record
Interrupted persistent saves are removed on server start so they cannot occupy slots forever

routes.title: Persistent worlds use a separate pool and lifecycle

stages.title: Eight persistent dimensions are registered independently
Persistent copy queue is separate from temporary cleanup
Mirror worlds do not generate external structures

routes.title: Commands cannot bypass the enchanted-mirror lifecycle

stages.title: Menu command resolves the held mirror stack
Save command is blocked unless the current session was permanence-enabled
Enter command is blocked unless the player still holds a matching enchanted mirror
Persistent record commands use player-facing selectors with autocomplete and localization
Admin commands expose persistent slots and all mirror kinds

routes.title: runClient smoke verification is reproducible from repo infra

stages.title: Smoke script launches runClient, waits for render/audio evidence, and cleans temporary processes/logs

routes.title: GameTest server verifies mirror lifecycle behavior at runtime

stages.title: Mirror lifecycle tests are registered in the mod namespace with a reusable empty template
Runtime tests cover mirror kind, permanence, cooldown, sandbox hotbar, default player state, and pristine terrain behavior
Smoke script runs Gradle's GameTest server entrypoint

routes.title: Built jars contain mirror lifecycle classes and resources
